summary: A woman reported her 22-year-old boyfriend suffered head and other injuries high on Mt. Sneffels in stormy weather. With help from other hikers the victim reached the trailhead, where an OMRT crew and ambulance were waiting.
notes: Mechanism of injury not reported; patient reached trailhead with help from other hikers.
